WITH category_averages AS (
    SELECT pc.product_type_description,
           AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity,
           AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS average_difference
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
    JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
    GROUP BY pc.product_type_description
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_difference) AS mean_difference
    FROM category_averages
), selected_categories AS (
    SELECT ca.average_quantity,
           ca.average_difference,
           om.mean_difference
    FROM category_averages AS ca
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
    WHERE ca.average_difference > om.mean_difference
)
SELECT AVG(average_quantity),
       AVG(average_difference),
       AVG(average_difference - mean_difference)
FROM selected_categories
